pack.name: Analysis & Reasoning
pack.author: PromptKey
pack.desc: Structured analysis templates: pros/cons, decision memo, data critique, risk scan

prompts.name: Decision Memo
prompts.content:
Turn the following into a decision memo: Context / Options (with pros & cons) / Recommendation / Risks / Next steps.

{{clipboard}}

prompts.name: Pros & Cons
prompts.content:
Analyze the following proposal. List pros and cons in a table, then give a one-paragraph verdict:

{{clipboard}}

prompts.name: Data Critique
prompts.content:
Critique the following data or chart description: what conclusions are supported, what is overclaimed, what data is missing?

{{clipboard}}

prompts.name: Risk Scan
prompts.content:

{{clipboard}}

prompts.content:

{{clipboard}}

prompts.name: Compare Options
prompts.content:

prompts.content:
